logical.byte_bit_rule: v3 b_S=b_R=1 means Byte/element, not 1-bit arithmetic. Encoded copies add physical occupancy, never logical payload.

physical.mode: 8-plane binary/SLC voltage-mode approximate ACIM; one native256x1024bank;8activeWL

neurosim_array_assignment.rule: Never substitute logical K,N for a physical array; preserve native banks, plane orientation, active rows, isolation and access direction.

physical.access_direction: NativecomputeWL selects one row duringwrite/verify;selected32physicalcolumns p=8c+w connectIDAC;othercolumnBL/SL equalpotentialinhibit,otherrowsgateoff;columnmodeisolation and8plane routing,notper-cellgatemux.22.4mA return strap/sink andcurrentcompliance must support selectedrow.

device.native_technology_policy: Retain native device bias/load/geometry independently of the low-voltage peripheral technology; no 28nm Technology table or enum relabeling.

normal_evaluation.physical_operation: Eight selected WLs, q=0..8 calibrated voltage levels, IM-biased column, replacement SAR then digital reconstruction.
normal_evaluation.bias_load_endpoint: Fixed IM and clamp, selected-gate high level, installed column/mux load; F_A must cover q=0 and q=1 as well as stronger codes.
included_in_cycle: input_step is part of the full F_A; media residual is F_A-input_step
normal_evaluation.qualification: F_A=10/20/50ns is an engineering reference budget, anchored only in the order of PCM-03 complete access; the replacement frontend has not been circuit-validated.

endpoint_verify.physical_operation: One selected WL and one cell per selected column, fresh reset/settle per pass, two-class endpoint check.
endpoint_verify.bias_load_endpoint: Same configured IM, clamp, selected-gate level and column/mux load as evaluation; inactive-branch changes need mode-specific threshold calibration and q=0/1 settling qualification.
endpoint_verify.qualification: Sharing F_A is a conditional design requirement, not measured equivalence; q=0/1 labels alone do not prove the eight-WL and one-WL paths settle equally.
endpoint_verify.source: PCM-03 PDF pp1-2 gives computation topology, not this single-cell verify; PCM-01 PDF pp4/8 gives endpoint separation and a different long-read implementation

long_observation_verify.physical_operation: Optional endpoint acceptance protocol: minimum256ns precharge+512ns observation, using the same local voltage-read path. Actual front=max(shared_front_ns,long_observation_ns), followed by SAR/comparison.
long_observation_verify.bias_load_endpoint: Uses the configured local voltage-read path and a separately commanded longer observation window. PCM-01 source instead uses0.2V PWM/CCO; its source bias and ADC transfer are not silently transplanted.
long_observation_verify.qualification: The768ns minimum observation is a conservative operation quota inspired by a different measured analog verify. It does not bound shared F_A uncertainty; shared settling longer than the minimum extends verify as well as evaluation.
long_observation_verify.source: PCM-01 PDF p8:0.2V,256ns precharge,512ns PWM for small conductance and continuous-target verify

write_control.physical_operation: 32IDAC, eight serial planes, reset/set and all endpoint reads before commit.
write_control.bias_load_endpoint: Same row/column isolation and rated return resources; complete pulse endpoints and three explicit mode transitions.
write_control.qualification: Pulse and route timing remain cross-implementation reference choices, not a measured full-bank update.
write_control.source: PCM-01 PDF p7; PCM-06 PDF p4 Fig6

native_electrical_parameter_policy.fallback: retain native complete service or stated primitive; never silently use upstream default device/load

voltage_sum.reference_verify_mode: same configured IM/clamp/load conditional mode,oneWL per verify; excludes optional0.2V weak observation mode

clock.service_boundary_rule: Keep physical completion time; align once when the next declared digital consumer accepts it. Do not round every native/internal substage. The declared setup/handshake margin is included before alignment; an exactly eligible edge adds no extra cycle. No added overlap or registers.

resources.capacity_policy: Installed capacity is not active parallelism. No extra ADC, SA, hold bank, driver or mux lane may appear without a resource edit.

mux_scope.rule: Ratios express selected outputs/local addresses; native row/layer/CIMSEL decoding is separate. No switch capacitance or RC assumed from fanin alone.

electrical_drive_outputs.meaning: Biased/current-driven electrical outputs; not a programming target count.

program_driver_channels.meaning: Explicit independent drive channels when reported; page-engine or distributed bias outputs do not establish this count.

selected_storage_targets.meaning: Addressed storage targets per selected_batch; phase and plane organization remain explicit.

logical_bits_per_target.meaning: One binary state/pair before INT8 plane and NAND encoding expansion.

physical_cells_per_target.meaning: Complementary storage branches per addressed target.

logical_payload_per_transaction.meaning: Workload payload for an indivisible resident transaction; not bias outputs or port beats.

encoded_bits_per_load_unit.meaning: Encoded bits in one native page for NOR/NAND; otherwise one resident transaction.

data_port_width.meaning: External encoded port width; not physical program parallelism.

update_domains.meaning: One native independently scheduled update domain.

implementation_plan.code_generation: No full NAND matrix and no model/dataset download.
comparison_only_modules: ShiftAdd: internal DFF/read-pulse capacity and overlap require separate proof
implementation_plan.next: Root integrates source probes and pins coverage decisions before Step 3.
implementation_plan.no_double_counting: Native opaque stages exclude replacement charges for their included stages. For constituent-mode stages, charge only listed primitives; calculator function is provenance, not a command to add its total again.
implementation_plan.digital_path_policy: Four distinct states: route_defined; native_module_probe_run (mechanism only); case_path_pending (no case closure); native_budget_retained. No path is qualified by an AdderTree/Adder/DFF component list.

service_schedules.semantics: Ordered loops; execute each nested stage before advancing the enclosing group/attempt. Top-level flat dependencies must not globally reorder phases. Zero new payload in maintenance.
